summary: STMicroelectronics N.V. filed a Form 6-K on August 19, 2026, announcing the posting of its IFRS 2026 Semi Annual Accounts and the Semi Annual IFRS Report 2026. The filing is a routine periodic financial report containing interim condensed consolidated financial statements, managing board report, and related disclosures. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or management change is present. The filing is a standard regulatory update for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
